info.name: Maven CRM — Email API
info.description:
Complete API reference for the email module. Base URL: {{base_url}}/api/v1/email

Set collection variable `base_url` to your server URL (e.g. http://localhost:5050).

Supports: raw send, templated emails (welcome, password-reset, OTP, application confirmation), connection verification, status, health, metrics, and production readiness.

request.description: Send a raw email with HTML and/or plain text content.

response.name: Rate Limited

request.description: Send a welcome email using the built-in template.
Send a password reset email with a custom reset link.
Send an OTP code email. Requires `to` and `otp`; `name` is optional.

response.name: Validation Error

request.description: Send a job application confirmation email. Requires `to`, `jobTitle`, and `companyName`.
Test the email provider connection (SMTP or SES depending on NODE_ENV). Returns 200 on success, 503 on failure.

response.name: Failure

request.description: Get current system status including provider, environment, sandbox info, circuit breaker state, and rate limiter state.

request.description: Comprehensive health check. Returns 200 (healthy) or 503 (degraded/unhealthy) with provider connection status, diagnostics, and warnings.

response.name: Healthy
response.body:
{
  "status": "healthy",

  "provider": "smtp",
  "providerConnected": true,
  "providerError": null,
  "queueEnabled": false,

    "Provider connection: OK",
    "SMTP configuration: OK",
